confidence.rationale: The ADMX contains two policy nodes named AllowAdvancedPasteAnthropic; duplicate policy names can make Group Policy reject the template.

proposed_comments.title: Remove the duplicate Anthropic ADMX policy
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the duplicate Anthropic ADMX policy

**Severity:** `high`

This adds `AllowAdvancedPasteAnthropic` near the top of the policies list while the PR also adds the same policy in the Advanced Paste provider-policy group later in the file. Keep the later PowerToys 0.96 entry and remove this misplaced copy.

```suggestion
    <policy name="ConfigureEnabledUtilityAdvancedPaste" class="Both" displayName="$(string.ConfigureEnabledUtilityAdvancedPaste)" explainText="$(string.ConfigureEnabledUtilityDescription)" key="Software\Policies\PowerToys" valueName="ConfigureEnabledUtilityAdvancedPaste">
```

confidence.rationale: Blank Anthropic model settings use this fallback directly, and Copilot/current Anthropic model guidance identify the Claude 3.5 Sonnet alias as retired.

proposed_comments.title: Use a current Anthropic default model
proposed_comments.body:
### Use a current Anthropic default model

**Severity:** `high`

When the user leaves the Anthropic model blank, this value is sent directly to the provider. The Claude 3.5 Sonnet alias is retired, so the default path fails for every blank-model configuration.

```suggestion
                AIServiceType.Anthropic => "claude-sonnet-4-6",
```

confidence.rationale: Advanced Paste configures API-key access to Anthropic services, which is governed by Anthropic API/Console commercial terms rather than Claude consumer terms.

proposed_comments.title: Link API users to Anthropic commercial terms
proposed_comments.body:
### Link API users to Anthropic commercial terms

**Severity:** `medium`

Advanced Paste asks for an Anthropic API key and connects to Anthropic services programmatically. The consumer terms are for Claude consumer plans, so provider setup should point API users at the commercial agreement instead.

```suggestion
            TermsUri = new Uri("https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms"),
```

confidence.rationale: Runtime credential lookup and Settings credential storage use service-specific resource/user names; Anthropic is absent from both maps, and the new package adds shipped DLL/signing and NOTICE obligations.

proposed_comments.title: Complete credential, policy, signing, and notice coverage
proposed_comments.body:
### Complete credential, policy, signing, and notice coverage

**Severity:** `high`

Please add Anthropic to the credential-vault resource maps used by both Settings and the Advanced Paste runtime; otherwise saved Anthropic API keys are stored under one identity and runtime lookup falls back to the OpenAI mapping, so requests fail as missing-key. Also enforce provider-specific GPO policy in the execution path, add `WinUI3Apps\Anthropic.dll` to the signing manifest, and add the Anthropic SDK source/copyright/MIT notice to `NOTICE.md` before release. These edits touch files outside the current upstream diff, so this is a general review note rather than an inline suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The upstream diff does not include Anthropic provider tests despite the PR body claiming them, and local restore fails before compilation because the configured feed cannot serve the new package.

proposed_comments.title: Add provider tests and align the package feed
proposed_comments.body:
### Add provider tests and align the package feed

**Severity:** `medium`

Please add automated coverage for factory registration, default-model fallback, endpoint handling, text/image message mapping, usage extraction, and length-truncation handling using a fake `IChatClient` so this provider is testable without a live API key. The new `Anthropic` package also needs to be available through the repository's configured package feed; local restore currently fails with NU1301/401 for `PowerToysPublicDependencies` before the project can compile.
